name: CloudGPU MCP
description: Compute infrastructure for AI agents. The agent finds GPUs, templates and open models on cloudgpu.app, gets a server quote, runs one-shot GPU jobs or interactive instances within spend, time and idle limits CloudGPU enforces, saves results and Workspaces, and destroys the GPU when done. Without an API key, connect_account returns a link: the user signs in once, approves a budget, and the agent gets its own key with a spending limit and expiry. CLOUDGPU_READ_ONLY=1 registers only the look-up tools.
author: CloudGPU

CLOUDGPU_API_KEY.description: API key from https://cloudgpu.app/api. Optional: without it, the agent can get its own budget-limited key through connect_account.

CLOUDGPU_MAX_SPEND_USD.description: Highest budget in USD the agent may set for one instance.

CLOUDGPU_MAX_HOURS.description: Longest time limit in hours the agent may set for one instance.

CLOUDGPU_READ_ONLY.description: Set to 1 to register only the look-up tools.
